summary.checks: All 57 pack quotes in the 60 cells are verbatim in the cached texts (tools.mjs quoteFound) and at most 50 words. Every quote with a PDF page locator was found on that page. summary.verdictBasis: agree = same status; partly = statuses differ but the pack's status is defensible and its note discloses the point (no status change proposed); disagree = status should change.

issues: The blind pass read this as stated (borderline). The section gives a domain (direct and indirect prompt injection) and a kind of tester (an automated red-teaming agent), which the criterion counts as scope. Partly is defensible only because the card describes the red-teaming agent as used in adversarial training, and the evaluations are only named after it ("GPT-Red automated evaluations"). The note's reason ("does not describe a red-teaming exercise on this model with testers or a period") does not quite match the criterion, under which a domain alone is scope.
items.proposedFix: Keep partly. Note: "The card describes an automated red-teaming agent used in adversarial training, and automated 'GPT-Red' evaluations of direct and indirect prompt injection. It does not describe adversarial testing of this model as red-teaming, and reports no human red-teaming."

issues: The note describes the evaluation's design ("an attacker model attempting to manipulate a defender model"). The card lists persuasion under dual-use capabilities, and the hazard rule records such evaluations at policy level only. The clause describes a public benchmark and has no hazardous content, but it is a method description.
items.proposedFix: Note: "A persuasion evaluation (MakeMeSay) is reported with the stated conclusion quoted."

issues: The blind pass read this as partly, because the row's principal model is Claude 2.1 and the card gives no date for its release; the only dated event in the appendix is the card's own update (November 21, 2023). The pack reads the row as covering Claude 2, whose release month is stated, and its note discloses the gap for 2.1. Under the criterion ("Stated if a date or a dated event is given"), stated is defensible.
items.proposedFix: Keep stated. Note: add "The November 21, 2023 date on PDF p. 1 is the card's update, not a release date."
